ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio observed with approximately 40% of the surface area composed of low-intensity black pixels and 60% high-intensity cream-white pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central peduncle area and narrow margins along the trailing edge are dominated by dark black pigmentation. Large contiguous cream-white zones are located on the distal portions of both lobes, containing dispersed low-intensity mottling and spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation with a shallow depth and a wide interior angle estimated between 140 and 150 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations detected across the entire continuous boundary, with more pronounced jagged peaks on the right lobe distal edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple small, circular high-intensity white clusters within the dark central pixels and several dark, roughly circular spots within the high-intensity cream region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct group of 4-5 parallel dark diagonal linear marks on the left lobe cream surface. Multiple intersecting light-colored linear marks are present in the central black region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring on the left lobe. Significant cluster of dark, high-relief pixels on the far right distal tip, indicating potential parasitic attachment or severe localized trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique parallel 'rake mark' pattern is present on the distal left lobe, consisting of roughly equidistant dark linear disruptions.
